found_by: the completeness direction of the content read. Item 3 is the first source the approved definition names and it contributed nothing to Pfizer's set, which only shows up when the untaken side of a declared range is read.
a_claim_that_was_not_true: docs/evidence/issue47_history/d02-content-read/finding.json said this was 'already registered as a separate defect'. It was written in prose in two READMEs and in AGENTS.md and was never in known_result_defects.json, which is the file that actually withdraws results. A defect recorded only in prose does not withdraw anything.

the_defect.rule: vnext.text_business_candidates._substantive rejects a linked block shorter than 120 characters
the_defect.what_it_drops: Pfizer's entire Item 3, which is one 77-character hyperlinked sentence: 'Certain legal proceedings in which we are involved are discussed in Note 16A.'
the_defect.the_control: Lumen's Item 3 is also a single block and also an incorporation by reference to a note - 'The information contained under the subheadings "Principal Proceedings" and "Other Proceedings, Disputes and Contingencies" in Note 17 ... is incorporated herein by reference.' - 226 characters, not hyperlinked, and it is taken. Same kind of content, opposite answers, and the difference is the anchor.
the_defect.severity: set composition rather than lost substance. Note 16A is taken in full ninety-one blocks over, so the disclosure the sentence points at is present; what was missing was the item's own text.

why_the_clause_could_not_simply_be_remov.what_those_fourteen_are: thirteen are the identical string 'Table of Contents'; the fourteenth is Pfizer's sentence.

the_repair.what_it_asks: the frozen rule again with the anchor taken off. Nothing new decides which is which: _substantive's own navigation-header pattern already rejects every one of the thirteen 'Table of Contents' blocks once the link flag stops answering first.
the_repair.why_no_second_discriminator: a repetition condition was written first and then measured: removing it changed nothing on any of the six filings, because the navigation-header pattern had already done that work. It was deleted rather than kept as an unexercised guard.
the_repair.placement: appended to D02's list, not added to the shared gate, so the change cannot move D03's regulatory candidates. This corpus does not distinguish the two placements - wiring it into the shared gate leaves every D03 set byte-identical - so the narrow placement is a bound on what the change can touch and is recorded as such rather than claimed to be tested.
the_repair.what_stays_open: a hyperlink of twelve characters or more that is not a navigation header and repeats inside a note scope would be admitted once per occurrence. No filing here holds one.

measured.method: the proposal record's own identity, not the candidate count: a change that swapped one block for another would leave the count alone.
